items.title: Whatever happened to the U.S. famine alert system that Trump shut down, then reopened
items.summary: The highly regarded FEWS NET network stopped posting data on Afghanistan, Somalia and Yemen -- then says it will start posting again in September. What's the reason for this back-and-forth?

headline: Kalshi bans former congressman George Santos for life after State of the Union trades

items.title: Kalshi bans former congressman George Santos for life after State of the Union trades
items.summary: Kalshi says Santos did not cooperate with its investigation into bets he placed on his own attendance at the State of the Union. The company also fined the disgraced congressman more than $71,000.

headline: Glacial flood death toll surpasses 900 in Nepal and Tibet

items.title: Glacial flood death toll surpasses 900 in Nepal and Tibet
items.summary: Rescuers battled mud and debris Monday as the death toll from devastating glacial floods along the China-Nepal border topped 900, with nearly 4,500 people still missing. Rescue teams continued a desperate search for survivors as entire communities were swept away.
